title: External tools (MCP)
intro: Connect a tool server so clones can use its tools.
loadFailed: The list of tool servers could not be read.
empty: No tool servers are connected yet. Choose Add a server to connect one by its web address or by a command, or Import from JSON to paste the setup snippet a tool publishes.
nameRule: Use 1 to 32 letters, digits, - or _ (no spaces).

add.name: Name
add.urlMissing: Enter the server address, starting with http:// or https://.
add.commandWarning: This runs a program on this computer with your permissions. Only add servers you trust.
add.commandMissing: Enter the command that starts the server, for example npx.

import.label: Paste a server list in JSON
import.hint: Many tools publish a setup snippet that starts with {snippet}. Paste it here as it is. Servers in it that run a command run on this computer with your permissions, so only import from sources you trust.

row.stillSaved: It is still saved. Check the {what}, then press Reconnect, or remove it and add it again.
row.connectingNote: Starting the connection. Its tools are listed once it connects.
row.disabledNote: Turned off. Clones cannot use its tools until you turn it on.
row.noTools: This server is connected but offers no tools.
row.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Clones will no longer be able to use its tools.
